This unit introduces students to the C programming language and systems-level programming concepts including memory management, file I/O, and process control.

Learning Outcomes

  • Demonstrate proficiency in C programming including pointers and dynamic memory
  • Implement memory allocation strategies and understand virtual memory
  • Design and implement concurrent programs using POSIX threads
  • Apply systems programming concepts to build a Unix shell

Assessment

Assessment Weight Due Length Description Use of AI
Assignment 1: Bit Manipulation 15% Week 4 Individual Implement bit manipulation operations in C Not permitted
Assignment 2: Memory Allocator 20% Week 8 Individual Design and implement a custom memory allocator Not permitted
Assignment 3: Shell 25% Week 12 Individual Build a Unix shell supporting pipes and redirection Not permitted
Final Exam 40% Exam period 2 hours Comprehensive exam covering all topics Not applicable
